input: Make my grandmother's akara shop go viral by Friday. I have six photos. I won't post every day.

response.answer:
THE SMUGGLED JOBS
- Social media campaign planning hides inside 'go viral'.
- Content calendar creation hides inside 'won't post every day'.
- Photo curation hides inside 'six photos'.

GOBLIN'S COUNTEROFFER
Your grandmother's akara shop is now the CEO of "going viral." I'll start by selecting the best photo for a single post. The rest will have to wait for the viral wave to recede.

COPY THIS WORK ORDER
```text
Goal: Prepare one social media post for akara shop.
Inputs: Six photos; [target audience]; [posting platform].
Deliverable: One curated photo and caption for a single post.
Acceptance: Photo is clear and relevant; caption is engaging and includes shop name; post is formatted for the specified platform.
Excludes: Daily posting, campaign strategy, viral outcome guarantee and all other photos.
```
